title: rsync Backup with Retention Pruning
description: rsyncs one or more source paths into a dated directory under a local destination on each target host, then prunes dated backups beyond a retention count -- fanned out across your inventory.

variables.name: SOURCE_PATHS
variables.prompt: Source path(s) to back up, space-separated

variables.name: DEST_BASE
variables.prompt: Local destination base directory (on each target host)

variables.name: EXCLUDE_PATTERNS
variables.prompt: rsync --exclude patterns, space-separated (leave empty for none)

variables.name: RETENTION_COUNT
variables.prompt: Number of dated backups to keep (0 = keep forever)
